Compliance review was limited to the supplied structured records for CLABSI-01 and SEP-B1. Available supporting references include sepsis surveillance and quality measure automation publications [F43], [F13].

For CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” the reporting period is 2026-Q1. The unit is per 1,000 line-days. The reported numerator is 63, the denominator is 887, exclusions are 37, and the reported rate is 74.12 per 1,000 line-days. The source record lists event dates of 2026-01-26, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-07, and 2026-11-02. Based on the supplied record, the compliance narrative can confirm that the measure contains the required core fields for measure identification, period, numerator, denominator, exclusions, rate, unit, and event-date listing.

For SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” the reporting period is 2026-Q2. The unit is percent. The reported numerator is 61, the denominator is 694, exclusions are 39, and the reported rate is 9.31 percent. The source record lists event dates of 2026-02-27, 2026-03-03, 2026-04-25, 2026-09-24, and 2026-11-13. Based on the supplied record, the measure includes the same core reporting fields: measure identifier, measure name, period, numerator, denominator, exclusions, rate, unit, and event dates.

No benchmark, target, prior-period value, statistical threshold, facility comparison, or corrective-action status was provided in the source records. Therefore, this narrative does not characterize performance as compliant or noncompliant against an external standard. It reports only the supplied measure values and confirms that the structured records contain the listed data elements for quality reporting review.
